1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 10 m de altura, con hojas elípticas y fruto ovoide globoso y verde, con numerosas semillas de color castaño oscuro; su fruto es comestible. Canellaceae; Pleodendron macranthum.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 10 m, with elliptical leaves and an ovoid-globular green fruit containing numerous dark brown seeds; its fruit is edible. Canellaceae; Pleodendron macranthum.
